# Stage 0 release anchor candidate

Generated by the ignored regression generator using the unchanged processing, raster, project, preset, and starter-look sources from release commit `7f7f7353ff315c73636e5e3afc7a82ac9e7a37be`. The only app edit in this worktree is the separate welcome-decoration fallback in `src/main.rs`.

Dimensions: 256×128. Rows 0–31 are a neutral ramp, 32–63 a channel ramp, 64–95 an HSV hue/value sweep, and 96–127 a small flat landscape with boundaries. Every x coordinate supplies one of the 256 alpha codes; alpha-zero pixels include nonblack RGB.

The candidate directory is review-only. The ignored generator refuses to overwrite it. After review, fixture files were copied with a bounded no-clobber copy into `tests/fixtures/release-0.2.0`.
